skills.name: Power method for the top eigenvector
skills.summary: Read power iteration as conditional gradient on the Rayleigh quotient.

skills.name: Brachistochrone and calculus of variations
skills.summary: Optional motivation, not required for later skills. A functional scores a curve, the Euler-Lagrange equation is the stationarity test, and the brachistochrone is a cycloid.

skills.name: Largest inscribed ellipsoid
skills.summary: Optional motivation, not required for later skills. An ellipsoid is a linear image of the unit ball, it lies in a polytope when a support inequality holds for every face, and maximizing log det of the shape is a convex problem.

skills.name: Trajectory planning as optimization
skills.summary: Optional motivation, not required for later skills. One open-loop grid scores a sequence once, and an obstacle can make the feasible set nonconvex.

skills.name: QR factorization
skills.summary: Factor a full-column-rank matrix as an orthonormal factor times an upper-triangular factor by orthogonalizing its columns.

video.title: QR Factorization

skills.name: Four fundamental subspaces
skills.summary: Split a matrix into its column space, row space, nullspace, and left nullspace, and use the two orthogonality relations among them.

video.title: The four fundamental subspaces

skills.name: Block matrix identities
skills.summary: Multiply and invert a two-by-two block matrix, and reduce the inverse with the Schur complement of an invertible block.

video.title: Block multiplication, the block inverse, and the Schur complement

skills.name: Principal component analysis
skills.summary: Take the leading eigenvectors of a covariance, or the leading right singular vectors of centered data, as the directions of greatest spread.

video.title: Directions of greatest spread in a data cloud

skills.name: Low-rank approximation
skills.summary: Keep the largest singular values and zero the rest. That truncation is the nearest matrix of a given rank in the Frobenius norm and in the spectral norm.

video.title: Nearest matrix of a given rank

skills.name: Perturbation of least squares
skills.summary: Bound how a change in the data matrix or the right-hand side moves a least-squares solution, using the ratio of the largest singular value to the smallest.

video.title: Parent concept: the matrix condition number, and how singular values scale errors

skills.name: Ridge regression
skills.summary: Add a squared penalty on the coefficients, or a general squared penalty on a linear image of them, and solve the shifted normal equations.

video.title: A squared penalty on the fitted coefficients

skills.name: Principal components regression
skills.summary: Replace the columns by the leading principal components, then solve an ordinary least-squares problem in that smaller coordinate.

video.title: Least squares in the leading principal-component coordinates

skills.name: Maximum likelihood estimation
skills.summary: Maximize the Gaussian density of the residuals. For independent equal-variance noise, that maximizer is the least-squares fit.

video.title: Choosing parameters that make the observations most likely

skills.name: Reparameterizing a convex problem
skills.summary: Change variables, move a constraint into the objective, or rewrite a problem so the same decisions are easier to recognize as convex.

video.title: Rewriting an objective as an epigraph constraint

skills.name: Strong convexity
skills.summary: Add a quadratic bowl of curvature m under a convex function, and test it by a Hessian that stays at least m times the identity.

video.title: A quadratic lower model of curvature m

skills.name: Gradient descent
skills.summary: Inside a descent iteration, take the direction opposite the gradient and a fixed positive step length, then repeat.

video.title: Stepping opposite the gradient of a cost

skills.name: Stochastic gradient descent
skills.summary: Replace the full gradient by an unbiased random draw from the data, and shrink the step length so the noise averages out.

video.title: An unbiased random gradient and a shrinking step

skills.name: Strong duality
skills.summary: Name when the dual maximum equals the primal minimum, including a relative-interior constraint qualification that forces a zero gap.

video.title: When the dual maximum equals the primal minimum

skills.name: Convex conjugates
skills.summary: Form the conjugate as the supremum of linear underestimators of a function, and use it to evaluate a dual function.

video.title: The supremum that defines a convex conjugate

skills.name: Maximum a posteriori estimation
skills.summary: Multiply a Gaussian likelihood by a Gaussian prior. The maximizer is a ridge fit, and the prior variance sets the penalty weight.

video.title: A Gaussian prior whose mode is a squared-penalty fit

skills.name: Lasso regression
skills.summary: Replace the squared penalty by an absolute-value penalty, and read sparsity off the corners of that penalty's unit ball.

video.title: An absolute penalty and the corners of its unit ball

skills.name: Convex quadratic programs
skills.summary: Write a quadratic objective with affine equalities and inequalities, and keep the program convex when the Hessian is positive semidefinite.

video.title: A quadratic objective with affine constraints

skills.name: Quadratically constrained quadratic programs
skills.summary: Allow quadratic inequality constraints, and keep each constraint convex when its Hessian is positive semidefinite.

video.title: Quadratic inequalities that stay convex

skills.name: Second-order cone programs
skills.summary: Constrain a Euclidean norm of an affine map by an affine upper bound, and recognize a convex quadratic constraint as one case.

video.title: A Euclidean norm bounded by an affine function

skills.name: Semidefinite programs
skills.summary: Constrain a symmetric affine matrix to be positive semidefinite. Linear, quadratic, and second-order-cone programs embed in this form by a Schur complement.

video.title: An affine matrix constrained to be positive semidefinite

skills.name: Conic duality
skills.summary: Write the dual of a cone program by swapping each cone for its dual cone, and compare the primal and dual values.

video.title: The dual of a cone program

skills.name: Lasso stationarity and soft thresholding
skills.summary: Write stationarity with a subdifferential of the absolute penalty, and reduce it to soft thresholding when the columns are orthonormal.

video.title: Stationarity of an absolute penalty, and the soft-threshold map

skills.name: Coordinate descent
skills.summary: Minimize along one coordinate while the others stay fixed, and use one pass of that update on a separable absolute penalty.

video.title: Minimizing one coordinate while the others stay fixed

skills.name: Newton's method with equality constraints
skills.summary: Solve one Newton step on an equality-constrained problem as a single linear system in the step and the multiplier.

video.title: One Newton step that keeps an equality feasible

skills.name: Barrier interior-point method
skills.summary: Add a log barrier on the strict inequalities, send its weight to zero, and take Newton steps on the equality-constrained barrier problem.

video.title: A log barrier whose weight is sent toward zero
